app.name: Totalvizibil
app.tagline: Where local businesses get built and found

feed.title: Find a local business you can trust
feed.lead: Browse active local businesses. Order is strictly our visibility score — you only filter by category and area.
feed.pickCategoryTitle: Choose a category to see businesses
feed.pickCategoryHint: Pick a field above. Listings only appear once you select at least a category.
feed.seoDesc: Active {category} businesses on Totalvizibil — ranked by visibility score, filtered by area.
feed.pickNiche: Pick a subcategory to narrow it down.

create.headline: Come with an idea. Leave with a business.
create.lead: Choose how much you want to steer. The rest of this flow is being redesigned.
create.easyText: A few quick answers and the assistant does the rest. Fast and simple.
create.advancedText: Control branding, tone, sections, SEO and more for a tailored result.
create.nextText: We're rethinking what happens after this choice — it isn't wired up yet.
create.registerLaterNote: No sign-up required to start — you'll register only to save and publish.

studio.title: Let’s build your site
studio.previewEmpty: Your site shows up here as you answer the assistant.
studio.turnsLeft: {n} messages left on the free plan
studio.loadError: Could not load the draft. Reload the page and try again.
studio.doneText: Saved as a draft. Next up is the location step.
studio.capText: Your basic site is ready. Continue with the location step to publish it to the feed.

studio.servicesEmpty: List your services in the chat, comma-separated — the AI writes the descriptions.
studio.uploadTooLarge: That image is too large (max 4 MB).

ph.name: Your company name…
ph.landing: The headline shown on the site…
ph.field: e.g. plumbing, beauty salon, cleaning company

msg.opening: Hi, I’m Andrei 👋 Let’s build your site in a few steps. First, pick a layout below.
msg.askColor: Got it. Now pick the site's main colour from the palette below.
msg.askLanding: Now the top section: upload a background image and, if you like, change the headline shown.
msg.askServices: List your services in the chat, comma-separated. I’ll write the descriptions.
msg.servicesGenerated: Done, I've written the service descriptions. Reorder them by drag & drop, or ask me to rewrite them.
msg.askPortfolio: Add up to 10 portfolio images. Hit “Continue” when you’re ready.
msg.askContact: Last step: a phone number and a contact email.
msg.done: Done! Your site is saved as a draft. Tweak anything below — about, reasons, testimonials, FAQ — or head to the location step.
msg.cap: You’ve used all the messages included in the free plan. You can continue with the next steps.
msg.alreadyDone: The site is finished. Adjust the sections below, or continue with the location step.
msg.askField: Great. What does the company do — its line of work? I need it to write the service copy well.
msg.askName: Good choice. What’s your company called?

studio.aboutPlaceholder: Write a few lines about the business… (leave empty for a suggested text)

templateDesc.classic: Balanced: intro, services as cards, then reasons and portfolio.
templateDesc.bold: High impact: big left-aligned headline, services as rows, portfolio early.
templateDesc.minimal: Airy and understated, text-led with fewer sections.

location.title: Where do you work?
location.lead: Pick your city and the radius you cover. This area decides where your business can appear in the feed.
location.mapHint: Click the map to move the exact point.
location.nationwideHint: The business appears in the feed for searches from any city — no fixed city and no km radius.
location.feedNote: You appear in the feed for searches within this area.
location.categoryHint: Pick the exact niche of your services — it is how customers find you in the feed.

claim.lead: Save “{business}” and publish it when you're ready.
claim.saveNote: Your website and location are saved to your account automatically.

claim.notEnough: Not enough in that wallet ({credits} credits needed).

dashboard.taskBudgetTitle: Set a campaign budget to publish your website in the feed
dashboard.taskBudgetText: Your website is saved as a draft. To appear in the feed it needs a campaign budget.
dashboard.taskBudgetDone: Your campaign is live — your business appears in the feed.
dashboard.noBusinessText: Build your business with the AI assistant and come back here.
dashboard.taskAdvancedText: Pay for the advanced plan from your wallet to unlock the full builder.
dashboard.taskLocationTitle: Set the area you appear in the feed
dashboard.taskLocationText: Pick your city and radius on the map — it decides where your business can show up.
dashboard.deleteText: Schedule the business for deletion — site, campaign and all data. You get 7 days to change your mind.
dashboard.deleteConfirmText: “{name}”, its site and campaign stop now and are permanently deleted after 7 days. You can cancel any time in that window. Wallet credits stay.
dashboard.walletShared: Shared wallet across all your businesses.

dashboard.upgradeText: Unlock the AI builder: control over sections, tone, branding and SEO. One-time fee.

alert.budgetText: The listing leaves the feed until tomorrow. Raise the daily budget if this happens often.

campaign.title: Budget & CPC
campaign.liveNote: Your campaign is live. Your business appears in the feed.
campaign.depletedNote: Not enough credits — the campaign stopped. Top up your wallet to resume it.
campaign.cpcInvalid: CPC must be between 0.05 and the daily budget.
campaign.appearFirstHint: The CPC that earns a full visibility score — set above the highest active CPC on the platform.
campaign.needCredits: You need {need} credits in the wallet · balance: {balance}

err.insufficient_credits: Not enough balance for the daily budget. Add credits.
err.wallet_blocked: The owner wallet is frozen. Unblock it to activate the campaign.
err.company_suspended: The business is suspended and cannot run campaigns.
err.website_builder_incomplete: Finish the advanced website builder before listing the campaign.

campaign.builderRequiredNote: This is an advanced-plan business. Build and finish its website before the campaign can go live.
campaign.cpcBelowMarketNote: The recommended CPC is now {rec} cr. Your {cur} cr bid scores {pct}% on visibility — raise it to hold your position.
campaign.pausedNote: The campaign is stopped. Re-activate it to show in the feed again. Its run-time score is kept for 24h, then it resets.
campaign.editStopsNote: Saving changes stops the campaign until you re-activate it.
campaign.autoLead: The platform runs the bidding for you.
campaign.autoP1: AUTO sets the CPC that earns you a full visibility score — but never above 10% of your daily budget per click.
campaign.autoP2: The campaign runs 24/7, within the daily budget cap you set.
campaign.autoP3: If your wallet runs out of credits, AUTO switches itself off.
campaign.autoMarket: Top competitor CPC right now: {n} cr.
campaign.autoMarketNone: No competing campaign active in your category right now.
campaign.cpcScoreLiveHint: Below the recommended CPC, the “Budget (CPC)” part of the score drops proportionally.

campaign.cpcMaxHint: Recommended CPC: {n} cr — the highest bid worth making for position #1.
campaign.autoDepletedNote: Today's budget is spent. AUTO resumes the campaign when the daily budget resets.
campaign.autoBudgetLimited: Your daily budget is too low for AUTO to reach a full CPC score — raise it so AUTO can bid the recommended CPC.

msg.opening: Hi! I'm the Totalvizibil assistant and I'll build you a complex website. Tell us what your business does.
msg.askName: Great. What is the business called?
msg.askCity: Which city are you in, or what area do you serve?
msg.askServices: List your main services, separated by commas.
msg.askAudience: Who are your ideal clients? (you can skip)
msg.askTone: What tone — professional, friendly, premium, calm or bold?
msg.askPages: Which pages do you want? e.g. about, services, portfolio, contact (or "all")
msg.askDesign: Which colour palette — blue, green, gold, grey or pink?
msg.askTypography: Which typography style — modern (grotesk), classic (serif) or technical (mono)?
msg.askContact: A phone number and an email for contact?
msg.generated: I've built the multi-page website — you can see it on the left.
msg.askRefine: Want me to adjust the colour, typography or tone? Type "done" if it looks good.

builder.editorEmpty: Select a section in the preview or the list to edit it.

analytics.intro: Real data from your ad and site: billed clicks, calls, form messages and how fast you reply. The visibility score sets your feed order.
